Important CYP2C9 substrates include warfarin, phenytoin, losartan, tolbutamide, and many NSAIDs (diclofenac, ibuprofen, celecoxib). Substrates bind with the site of metabolism positioned close to the reactive ferryl-oxo species, while an acidic functional group (carboxylate, acidic NH) interacts with Arg108 near the active site entrance.
